title: Chatbot
subtitle: Let members talk to the bot in chosen channels, and manage who can use it and how much.
paused: The chatbot is paused until {time} because its AI service ran out of credit. Members get a short notice meanwhile.

reauth.title: Sign in again
reauth.body: Changing the AI service's address or key needs a login from the last few minutes. Sign in again, then repeat the change.
reauth.failed: Could not start the sign-in. Please try again.

settings.title: Chatbot
settings.intro: The bot only replies when a member mentions it or replies to one of its messages. To answer, it reads the recent messages of the channel and sends them, with the question, to the configured AI service, so members' text is shared with that provider.
settings.defaultLimitHelp: From 0 to {max}. A member can get a limit of their own in the Usage tab.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: The channels where the chatbot answers, at most {max}. A channel used by a game cannot be added.
channels.empty: No channel yet. The chatbot stays silent until you add one.
channels.full: This server has the most channels the chatbot can use. Remove one to add another.

llm.title: AI service

sources.global: The service shared by all servers

llm.noneHint: No AI service is set up, so the chatbot cannot answer yet. Save one for this server below.
llm.ownHelp: Optional. Without one, the bot uses the service shared by all servers when it is available.
llm.useSharedPlan: This server's own address and key are deleted. The chatbot then uses the service shared by all servers.
llm.useSharedPlanNone: This server's own address and key are deleted. No shared service is available, so the chatbot cannot answer until you save one again.
llm.usingShared: This server's own service is deleted.

memory.title: Memory
memory.description: The bot keeps short summaries of what it learns about channels and members. They are never shown here, only counted and cleared.
memory.pickMember: Type a name to find a member
memory.plan: The bot forgets {members, plural, one {# member summary} other {# member summaries}} and {channels, plural, one {# channel summary} other {# channel summaries}}.
memory.done: {count, plural, one {# summary was} other {# summaries were}} cleared.

usage.title: Usage in {month}
usage.description: Members without a limit of their own get {limit} tokens a month. Counts start again each month.
usage.pickMember: Type a name to find a member
usage.empty: Nobody has used the chatbot this month.
usage.limitHelp: From 0 to {max}. 0 stops this member from using the chatbot.
usage.limitCleared: The member now has the server limit.
usage.grantHelp: A whole number up to {max}. Use a negative number to take back tokens given earlier.
usage.resetPlan: The {used} tokens {name} has used this month are set back to 0. Tokens added this month stay.
usage.resetNothing: {name} has not used any tokens this month.

history.title: History
history.description: The bot's exchanges with members, kept for {days} days and then deleted automatically.

filters.member: Type a name to find a member

history.empty: No exchange has been logged yet.

delete.title: Delete exchanges
delete.plan: {count, plural, one {# exchange} other {# exchanges}} will be deleted for good. An exchange still waiting for its answer is kept.
delete.done: {count, plural, one {# exchange was} other {# exchanges were}} deleted.

detail.title: Exchange
detail.plainNotice: Everything below is what members wrote and what the model answered, shown as plain text.
detail.question: Question
detail.contextLost: The saved context could not be read.
